people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
translations.bsb: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made gods of gold for themselves.
translations.kjv: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
translations.asv: And Moses returned unto Jehovah, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
